text: Cute floating island with a tomato patch and a white bunny-like creature. Day 2, 10 coins, Lv1. Hint says tap the ripe crop - tapping the tomatoes.
Harvested, sowed, watered. Day/night cycle is 30 sec, pretty fast. The bunny is a Momo - a worker. Now it wants me to pick tiles for the Momo with a pencil.
Momo is now farming on its own - +3 coins, +3 EXP, income went to 9/min. Satisfying. Mailbox has a red dot and an envelope bubble over the farm. Checking mail.
A cute letter from Momo proposing field expansion research. Love the postcard style. Tapping Let's research it.
Research tree with many tabs (Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games...). Field expansion needs 3 flasks + 20 coins. I need a research lab. Tapping Build a research lab.
Build menu appeared. Research lab opens at Lv2, I'm Lv1 50/90. Farm costs 10, I have 40. Building another farm in the meantime.
Reached Lv2! Momo moved to the second farm by itself. Research lab should be unlocked now. Trying tapping empty grass to build.
Research lab building. Hint says island can grow here for 40 coins - land expansion. I have 29. First farm has ripe tomatoes while Momo works the second one, so I'll harvest it myself.
Lab is built. My tap selected the Momo instead of the farm - it now shows a numbered route 1-2-3 covering both farms and the lab, apparently added automatically. Nice. Tapping the lab.

Bought land for 40 - the island grew a new tile at the bottom right with a bush. Got a tip panel about building on any empty tile and demolishing for half refund. Next: mail, then build a farm on the new tile.
Third farm going up on the front tile. Lab has produced 4 flasks. Research button has a red dot - opening it to start Field expansion.
Research started (20s). Lv3 now. All three farms are ripe while Momo sits in the lab - one Momo isn't enough. I'll harvest by hand and then look at Hire.
Crops ripen within seconds after watering. Next land tile costs 55 now (was 40). I have 64. Before buying land, checking what Hire costs since my one Momo is stretched thin.
Hiring a second Momo costs 100, I have 82. Saving for it. Research has a red dot again, checking.
Watering efficiency is 1.5 minutes for -25% wait. I have 112 now so hiring the second Momo first.
Hired a second Momo named Mochi! It's on free time. Tapping Assign to give it work.

Tried to assign Mochi to the front farm, but it says Another Momo works here - the first Momo was already there. Bit confusing which bunny is which. Using the pencil to give Mochi the two back farms instead.
Mochi has a route over the top and front farm. Income now 102/min. I'm curious about the Next: City 0/4 label in the top-left, tapping it.
Found a clear goal: becoming a City needs Land 5/9, Momo 2/3, Research levels 1/3, Value 330/1.5K. That gives me direction. Plan: research Watering efficiency and buy land.
Bigger harvests: crops +1 for 8 flasks and 60 coins, 2 min. I have 180. Starting it. Mochi's card says 0 -> 10.5 jobs a day since the change, nice feedback.
Island has 6 tiles now, with two empty grass tiles. Lv3 should unlock the Mine. Tapping the new tile to see build options.
Mine costs 120 coins plus 10 Wood, so I need a Lumberyard first (80). I have 173 - building the Lumberyard.
Lv4. Lumberyard done, a Momo walked over and is felling a tree (Fell / Replant). Now checking the Special building on the last empty tile.
Special = landmarks: Clock Tower (Lv5), School (400 + wood 30 + stone 20), Momo Monument (Lv6). Long-term goals. Not affordable yet. Going to check hiring a 3rd Momo for the City goal instead.
Hired Pomu, City goal now 1/4. Want Pomu on the Lumberyard for wood, but the Momo panel covers the lumberyard tile. Trying Assign.
Again 'Another Momo works here' - I can't tell which bunny is Pomu and who's at the lumberyard. Wood is going up anyway (6). Giving up on that, starting Watering efficiency research instead.
Bigger harvests finished: each harvest gives 9 now, income ~181/min. Started Watering efficiency. One more research level needed for the City. New mail waiting too.
Mochi suggests a tree nursery - added to the research list. 258 coins, one minute left: buying more land for the City goal.
Bought a 7th land tile, and wood just hit 10 so the Mine is affordable now. Building it with my last seconds.
Mine under construction (7 sec), income 235/min, Lv4. Waiting to see it finish.
Mine is built and a Momo went straight in to Dig. Island feels alive with 3 bunnies, farms, lab, lumberyard and mine. Would keep playing to reach City.
